taste:
This is a light, crisp white wine with a dry flavour profile and a clean, acidic finish. Green apple and pear provide subtle fruit notes, while a hint of sharp citrus gives it a zesty edge. The fruit character does not make it a sweet wine: dryness and freshness are the defining qualities. Its pale straw colour matches the light style described in the menu information.

Served chilled, it suits a warm afternoon or a light evening meal. The acidity offers a useful contrast to richer food, with battered cod specifically suggested in the description. A side salad is another suggested match if you want food alongside without moving towards a richer pairing.
